tweet: Kounde’s ankle remains in pain after a severe sprain; medical tests ruled him out of the PSG match, and the current state of the joint makes a Sunday start unlikely – Flick may still wait, but the outlook is pessimistic.

title: Barcelona defender’s nightmare against PSG and the flashbacks of the 2024 season it brings
tweet: Cancelo’s outing against PSG mirrored the 2024 shock at the Parc des Princes – a yellow card, a flanked failure that opened the left, and a switch to right that left the team exposed for the final goal. The pattern of defensive lapses against the French side is a reminder that his recent attacking flair has not fixed the gaps at back, and the next Clasico will test whether he can shed those 2024 ghosts.

title: Six options for Hansi Flick to turn to following Barcelona midfielder’s injury
tweet: Olmo out four weeks, the midfield remains stocked but his unique creative spark is missing. Gavi’s versatility could fill the gap, yet he prefers deeper areas – a risk if the attack needs a sharp passer. The decision will test Flick’s willingness to shift roles or rely on established options.

title: Barcelona’s worrying defensive record heading into the game against Real Madrid
tweet: Barcelona have conceded 15 goals in 12 matches, averaging 1.25 per game, with six coming in the Champions League. The bulk of the damage has come from set‑pieces and a rotating back line. As things stand, the pressure will be on Flick to tighten the defence before the Clasico, but whether that can be achieved in the space of a single match remains to be seen.

title: Barcelona dressing room believes PSG defeat will help the team for El Clasico
tweet: Barcelona lost to PSG, but the result may sharpen the squad for El Clásico. The players cited injuries, travel fatigue and squad rotation as dampeners; with those removed, the focus can shift to Real. As things stand, the defeat is a useful reset rather than a setback.
